verses.arabic: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.english: Qaf. By the glorious Quran.
verses.transliteration_html: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi
verses.transliteration_text: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi

verses.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.english: Indeed they consider it odd that a warner from among themselves should have come to them. So the faithless say, ‘This is an odd thing.’
verses.transliteration_html: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun
verses.transliteration_text: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
verses.english: ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust, [shall we be raised again]? That is a far-fetched return!’
verses.transliteration_html: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun
verses.transliteration_text: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun

verses.arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.english: We know what the earth diminishes from them, and with Us is a preserving Book.
verses.transliteration_html: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun
verses.transliteration_text: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun

verses.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.english: Indeed, they denied the truth when it came to them; so they are now in a perplexed state of affairs.
verses.transliteration_html: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin
verses.transliteration_text: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
verses.english: Have they not, then, observed the heaven above them, how We have built it and adorned it, and that there are no cracks in it?
verses.transliteration_html: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin
verses.transliteration_text: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
verses.english: And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and caused every delightful kind [of vegetation] to grow in it.
verses.transliteration_html: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin
verses.transliteration_text: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin

verses.arabic: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
verses.english: [In this there is] an insight and admonition for every penitent servant.
verses.transliteration_html: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin
verses.transliteration_text: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin

verses.arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَـٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.english: We send down from the sky salubrious water, with which We grow gardens and the grain which is harvested,
verses.transliteration_html: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi
verses.transliteration_text: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
verses.english: and tall date palms with regularly set spathes,
verses.transliteration_html: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun
verses.transliteration_text: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun

verses.arabic: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.english: as a provision for Our servants, and with it We revive a dead country. Likewise will be the rising [from the dead].
verses.transliteration_html: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju
verses.transliteration_text: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.english: The people of Noah denied before them, and [so did] the people of Rass and Thamud,
verses.transliteration_html: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu
verses.transliteration_text: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu

verses.arabic: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
verses.english: and ‘Ad, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
verses.transliteration_html: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin
verses.transliteration_text: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.english: and the inhabitants of Aykah and the people of Tubbac. Each [of them] impugned the apostles, and so My threat became due [against them].
verses.transliteration_html: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi
verses.transliteration_text: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi

verses.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
verses.english: Have We been exhausted by the first creation? No, they are in doubt about a new creation.
verses.transliteration_html: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin
verses.transliteration_text: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.english: Certainly We have created man and We know to what his soul tempts him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
verses.english: When the twin recorders record [his deeds], seated on the right hand and on the left:
verses.transliteration_html: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun
verses.transliteration_text: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun

verses.arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
verses.english: he says no word but that there is a ready observer beside him.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun
verses.transliteration_text: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.english: The throes of death bring the truth: ‘This is what you used to shun!’
verses.transliteration_html: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu
verses.transliteration_text: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.english: And the Trumpet will be blown: ‘This is the promised day.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi
verses.transliteration_text: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
verses.english: Every soul will come accompanied by [two angels], a driver, and a witness:
verses.transliteration_html: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun
verses.transliteration_text: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
verses.english: [he will be told] ‘You were certainly oblivious of this. We have removed your veil from you, and so today your eyesight is acute.’
verses.transliteration_html: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.english: Then his companion [angel] will say, ‘This is what is ready with me [of his record of deeds].’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun
verses.transliteration_text: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun

verses.arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
verses.english: [The two angels accompany him will be told,] ‘Cast every obdurate ingrate into hell,
verses.transliteration_html: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin
verses.transliteration_text: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin

verses.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.english: [every] hinderer of good, transgressor, and skeptic,
verses.transliteration_html: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin
verses.transliteration_text: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.english: who had set up another god along with Allah and cast him into the severe punishment.’
verses.transliteration_html: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi
verses.transliteration_text: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi

verses.arabic: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
verses.english: His companion [devil] will say, ‘Our Lord! I did not incite him to rebel [against You], but he was [himself] in extreme error.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin
verses.transliteration_text: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.english: He will say, ‘Do not wrangle in My presence, for I had already warned you in advance.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi
verses.transliteration_text: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi

verses.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.english: The word [of judgement] is unalterable with Me, and I am not tyrannical to My servants.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi
verses.transliteration_text: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
verses.english: The day when We shall say to hell, ‘Are you full?’ It will say, ‘Is there any more?’
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin

verses.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.english: And paradise will be brought near for the Godwary, it will not be distant [any more]:
verses.transliteration_html: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin
verses.transliteration_text: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
verses.english: ‘This is what you were promised. [It is] for every penitent and dutiful [servant]
verses.transliteration_html: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin
verses.transliteration_text: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin

verses.arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.english: who fears the All-beneficent in secret and comes with a penitent heart.
verses.transliteration_html: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin
verses.transliteration_text: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.english: Enter it in peace! This is the day of immortality.’
verses.transliteration_html: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi
verses.transliteration_text: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi

verses.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
verses.english: There they will have whatever they wish, and with Us there is yet more.
verses.transliteration_html: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun
verses.transliteration_text: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.english: How many generations We have destroyed before them, who were stronger than these, insomuch that they ransacked the towns?! So, is there any escape [from Allah’s punishment]?
verses.transliteration_html: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin
verses.transliteration_text: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
verses.english: There is indeed an admonition in that for one who has a heart, or gives ear, being attentive.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days, and any fatigue did not touch Us.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.english: So be patient at what they say, and celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the sunset,
verses.transliteration_html: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi
verses.transliteration_text: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.english: and glorify Him through part of the night and after the prostrations.
verses.transliteration_html: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi
verses.transliteration_text: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi

verses.arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
verses.english: And be on the alert for the day when the caller calls from a close quarter,
verses.transliteration_html: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin
verses.transliteration_text: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.english: the day when they hear the Cry in all truth. That is the day of rising [from the dead].
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.english: Indeed it is We who give life and bring death, and toward Us is the [final] destination.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru
verses.transliteration_text: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
verses.english: The day the earth is split open for [disentombing] them, [they will come out] hastening. That mustering is easy for Us [to carry out].
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.english: We know well what they say, and you are not there to compel them. So admonish by the Quran those who fear My threat.
verses.transliteration_html: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi
verses.transliteration_text: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi
